sql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN T1.listings_mentioning > T2.listings_mentioning THEN 'Python' ELSE 'SQL' END AS more_in_demand
FROM mart_skill_demand AS T1
INNER JOIN mart_skill_demand AS T2 ON T1.family = T2.family
WHERE
  T1.skill = 'Python' AND T2.skill = 'SQL' AND T1.scope = 'all' AND T2.scope = 'all'
ORDER BY
  T1.listings_mentioning DESC,
  T2.listings_mentioning DESC
LIMIT 1;
